Message:
smb3: rename encryption/decryption TFMs

Detach the TFM name from a specific algorithm (AES-CCM) as
AES-GCM is also supported, making the name misleading.

s/ccmaesencrypt/enc/
s/ccmaesdecrypt/dec/
